RFC2545-3-1.note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after f8ca08b2ca). Section 3: "A BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address of Next Hop field the global IPv6 address of the next hop, potentially followed by the link-local IPv6 address of the next hop." Changed units read diff by diff. TestRFC2545ReceivedPairSecondAddressValidated and TestRFC2545ReceivedPairFirstAddressValidated moved the inline receive/forward body into rfc2545ReceiveForwardPublished, which keeps every prior check (original UPDATE unchanged, intact publication, exactly one publication when not withdrawn, RS direct-rail and export-fallback decisions); no assertion was dropped. The receiving session now negotiates capability 77 only where a case asks for it, so the RFC 2545 egress refusal of an invalid first address (link-local, IPv4-mapped, loopback, ::, multicast) and of an invalid second address (global, ::, multicast) is still asserted with exact native bytes on cap77-neither and cap77-destination sessions, and for link-local and :: first addresses on cap77-source sessions too, where draft Section 6 admits the field. On cap77-source sessions the shapes draft Section 6 calls malformed are now withdrawn at receipt (exact MP_UNREACH, legacy sibling withdrawn, nothing announced). TestRFC2545EffectivePairPolicyAndMixedSibling keeps every policy/legacy-sibling case on a non-cap77 receiver and adds one cap77-source withdrawn case. Global controls remain exact positives. Finding (no verdict change): the cap77-source receipt-withdrawal clauses added to the 3-1 claims prove draft-ietf-idr-linklocal-capability Section 6, not RFC 2545 Section 3, which says nothing about receipt; they belong under DRAFT-IETF-IDR-LINKLOCAL-CAPABILITY-6-1. All four changed units pass at HEAD (go test -v, 572 subtests PASS).

RFC2545-3-2.note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after f8ca08b2ca). Section 3: "The value of the Length of Next Hop Network Address field on a MP_REACH_NLRI attribute shall be set to 16, when only a global address is present, or 32 if a link-local address is also included in the Next Hop field." The only changed carrier is TestRFC2545EffectivePairPolicyAndMixedSibling: its 3-2 claims and cases (native IPv4 and VPN-shaped fields refused under IPv6 unicast, legal 16/32-octet policy replacements announced with exact bytes, legacy siblings unchanged) are byte-identical in substance; the receiving session now lacks capability 77 for those cases, which does not touch the width path because every received field is a 32-octet pair that needs no capability. The one added case (cap77-source invalid second address) is a draft Section 6 receipt withdrawal and carries no width claim. The receive/forward helper refactor keeps every prior assertion. Other 3-2 carriers unchanged. Verdict stands.

RFC2545-3-3.note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after 990744517c and f8ca08b2ca). Section 3: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." Tested is 'only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to.'; Gap is 'The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if'; Producer internal/component/bgp/reactor/link_scope.go::linkLocalNextHop. Annotation unchanged. linkLocalNextHop gained a linkLocalCondition argument: linkLocalConditionFor returns the RFC 2545 joint condition (sharesNextHopSubnet via holdsCommonSubnet) for every family except AFI 2/SAFI 128, which takes RFC 4659 Section 3.2.1.1's peer-only condition (owner decision 2026-10-19). For RFC 2545 families the decision is unchanged, and the ThirdParty/Unspecified router branch still returns no address, so the Gap is exactly as recorded. TestRFC2545ReceivedPairSubnetConditions now splits the VPN-IPv6 global-off-link case to keep the pair (RFC 4659), while the unicast cases still assert exact 32-octet keep only when both entities share one prefix and an exact 16-octet trim when either is off-link; the VPN subcases test RFC 4659 under an RFC 2545 tag but do not weaken the unicast proof. TestRFC2545StaticLabeledIPv6LinkLocalCommonSubnet (SAFI 4) asserts the exact 32-octet field on the common subnet and the 16-octet global off it. No discrimination record for RFC2545-3-3 is reported unverified by ./le rfc check. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.

RFC2545-3-4.note: Re-judged 2026-10-12 (independent auditor) after owner-approved lint-only edits in 96ec49327b and 4e731b2d96; the row text is unchanged and each changed unit was re-read diff by diff. TestRFC2545JointSubnetWriter builds the same 32-octet pair with slices.Concat; TestDefaultOriginateOmitsLinkLocalWhenPeerOffLink takes the same local and link-local addresses from constants. No assertion changed. Verdict stands. RFC2545 Section 3 requires only the global IPv6 address, with next-hop length 16, in all other cases; sharesNextHopSubnet now requires one connected prefix containing recipient and effective global, so separate memberships in different local prefixes cannot license a pair; configured/default/direct/static writers, ordinary batch/queued/commit normalization, and applyEgressNextHopScope on cached and RS forwarding preserve the global and native NLRI while excluding the link-local outside that joint condition, and stored replay carries the complete supplied field into the same forwarding core; the inspected carriers assert exact address fields and unchanged reachability, with common-link positives retaining the pair and split-link/entity-off-link/recipient-off-link controls producing global-only output; TestRFC2545ForwardPolicyOwnGlobalJointSubnet additionally drives both forwarding rails, Auto/Unchanged and operation/raw-policy fallback, checking required own-pair inclusion on the common link, global-only output off-link, an unchanged independent legacy sibling and one policy invocation; Main's observed broad and final-guard race20 runs and real public raw-export SDK old/final workflow establish this current carrier, complementing the previously accepted distinct-namespace matrix80, replay80, restored FRR same/split complete captures and repaired Docker/compatibility evidence; the missing third-party link-local source belongs to the inclusion branch, not this otherwise obligation; capability-77 standalone link-local and RFC4659 VPN forms retain their separate contracts; no new run or canonical-record freshness is claimed by the reviewer Rejudged 2026-10-12 after commit ce62c78c3b moved peer_initial_sync_test.go around these units: the tagged functions there were re-read and are byte-identical, their assertions and fixtures still carry the evidence this note cites, and the other cited units did not change, so the verdict stands. Rejudged 2026-10-12 after 7a637d6df5 renamed SendUpdateHeld to sendUpdateHeld in two comments of peer_initial_sync_test.go: every tagged unit cited here is byte-identical (gate-verified), the comment edits sit outside them, and the assertions and fixtures still carry the evidence this note cites, so the verdict stands. Rejudged 2026-10-17 (independent reader, not the author of 3f6bb1965e) after the owner-approved command-text change in 3f6bb1965e (injection grammar: nlri <family> became mp <family> for MP families and bare nlri for IPv4 unicast): the only changed carrier is test/encode/new-v6.ci, whose cmd=api lines changed spelling only; the expected UPDATE hex is byte-identical and still requires the global address alone with length 16 toward a peer that shares no subnet with the next hop. Re-run green 2026-10-17. RFC 2545 Section 3: "In all other cases a BGP speaker shall advertise to its peer in the Network Address field only the global IPv6 address of the next hop (the value of the Length of Network Address of Next Hop field shall be set to 16)." Every other tagged unit is unchanged. Verdict stands.

RFC2545-3-6.note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after 990744517c). Section 3: "The link-local address shall be included in the Next Hop field if and only if the BGP speaker shares a common subnet with the entity identified by the global IPv6 address carried in the Network Address of Next Hop field and the peer the route is being advertised to." The only change to linkLocalNextHop is the per-family linkLocalCondition argument (RFC 4659 peer-only condition for VPN-IPv6, RFC 2545 joint condition otherwise); the switch on nextHopRouter still returns the zero address for nextHopRouterThirdParty and nextHopRouterUnspecified, and classify still names Speaker only for the connected endpoint, configured local address and held addresses. So a configured/static/API route or explicit rewrite naming another on-link router by its global still has no source for that router's link-local, and the speaker's own is correctly not substituted. Gap stands; {gap} annotation and Partial public support remain accurate.
